description: Job posting volume trends on startup.jobs, optionally filtered by role and/or country. The free tier returns a 12-month summary with year-over-year change; full access unlocks the monthly time series (up to 36 months).

months.description: How many months of history (default 12, full access only)

role.description: Role slug from list_roles (specific roles only, not top-level categories)
